title: pvStitchImageDataWithGhosts
body:
## pvStitchImageDataWithGhosts

Joins image blocks that are separated by a one-voxel gap, such as blocks written independently by each process, by generating ghost points at the new interfaces, so the partitions behave as one continuous image. Input is image data or a composite of images with point data only. Use it before contouring or gradients on such tiled images to avoid gaps.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Inputs with any cell data are rejected; remove cell arrays first (passArrays).
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `StitchImageDataWithGhosts`. Identity: `filters/StitchImageDataWithGhosts`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input. Accepted data: composite data (multiblock or partitioned collections) (vtkCompositeDataSet); image data (uniform rectilinear grids) (vtkImageData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkCompositeDataSet","vtkImageData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `NumberOfGhosts` | Number of ghost layers requested at each stitched interface. The value 1 only closes the one-voxel gap; each increment adds one ghost cell layer (n gives n - 1 layers) for filters that need wider stencils. | `{"maximum":10,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |

```json
  "id": "result",

  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
